capabilities: Search a linked source text note as you type
Insert quotes into the current note and resize them with arrow keys
Import ePub files as Markdown source notes
Link a source note via a configurable source_text property
disambiguation: Not a highlight-syncing tool like Readwise; it searches a source text already in the vault rather than collecting highlights.
extras: The ePub import is deliberately feature-complete; the author points users needing more to Pandoc or Calibre.
motivation: The author reads paper books or on an eReader while taking notes on another device, and stopping to capture quotes "massively interrupts my flow".
problem: Capturing direct quotes from a book while taking notes means retyping them by hand or syncing highlights through an external service.

relations.evidence: Highlight/capture, and sync with a tool like Readwise

summary: Quote insertion tool that fuzzy-searches a source text note (e.g. an imported ePub) and inserts excerpts into the current note as you type.
